scope: Directly load, JSON-export, calculate and report a source-fingerprinted .opi file whose bytes are an exact copy of the accepted K02.var01 native .sxi model. This tests the SIMLOX common-format .opi extension path under CLI, not OPUS10-generated input content or a two-file merge.

manual.rule: SIMLOX and OPUS10 use the same native input representation. SIMLOX can open .sxi and .opi files; this run checks the .opi direct-open path only. Actual OPUS10 result-point .opo import is a separate GUI workflow.

frozen_delta: Copy accepted K02 named native model.sxi bytes to immutable local model.opi without changing content; no model or business parameter changes.
acceptance_hypotheses: The copied .opi has the same byte count and SHA-256 as the accepted K02 .sxi, and the accepted K02 closure/source pins still match.
SIMLOX opens the .opi by filename, exports valid JSON, calculates a nonempty SXO with zero converter errors and only reviewed warnings, and exports a nonempty report under guarded session-0 SSH.

JSON export retains every K02 named authored business table, including the documented native empty-default Station canonicalization. Event log and numeric report equal the accepted K02 run, with a single mission launch h8 and success h11.
gate: Publish only if direct .opi open, native JSON export, calculation, event/report parity and independent raw-seal replay pass. Otherwise keep a diagnostic. Do not infer OPUS10 provenance, OPI/SXI merge, OPO allocation points or phase-scenario import.
execution_guard: Session-0 SSH with sshd ancestor, host-wide Issue #18 mutex, protected GUI PID13340/session1 identity, immutable run path, targeted child watchdog, source hashes before/after and raw SHA-256 closure.
limits: One copied self-built .opi extension of an accepted .sxi; no OPUS10 executable or OPUS10-generated source, no OPI/SXI merge, OPO result point, LORA, phase scenario, GUI, cross-engine or general K06 claim.
